back: A framework of members joined at their ends to form triangles.

front: Why are triangles used in frameworks?
back: A triangle cannot change shape unless a side changes length, so it is rigid.
A framework member in tension; it can be thin, even a cable.

front: Give three advantages of trusses over solid beams.
back: High strength-to-mass ratio, less material (cheaper), can span long gaps.

front: What does the tie beam of a roof truss do?
back: It is in tension and stops the rafters pushing the walls apart.

front: How can you tell whether a model's member is a tie?
back: Replace it with string: if the frame still holds, the member was in tension.
